name: Lizzie Borden
depiction: Illustrated representation, not a likeness: a generic woman in her early thirties in a dark, high-collared 1890s gown with her hair pulled back (the figure rig has no bun, so a tight swept-back style stands in for hair worn up). No portrait or photograph is copied. Acquitted in 1893: always shown with neutral or restrained expressions, never as guilty, never with any weapon.
rules: Never shown with the victims, any weapon or the crime itself. Burned dress is shown only as cloth in a stove. Restrained expressions only.
